subject: Marketplace addendum: pass-through billing, audit evidence & indemnity — CloudCart
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex@cloudcart.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena_ruiz@cloudcart.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum - clarifying pass-through billing & audit evidence

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is CloudCart's proposed addendum (v2) — the key asks from our side are:

- Confirm pass-through of marketplace fees (language we saw in section 3.2) applies to resold subscriptions and metered usage.
- We need a clear audit-evidence path: our finance team will request receipts or invoice-level records from Redwood in case of marketplace reconciliation.
- Indemnity carveouts: our legal team asked for a narrower carveout related to third-party marketplace liabilities; we marked a suggested clause in the doc.

Can you confirm Redwood is comfortable providing invoice-level evidence (CSV/per-period) for usage-based charges and what the retention window would be? Also — do you have any constraints around providing raw receipts to partners?

Attachment: CloudCart_Proposed_Addendum_v2.docx (docx)

Happy to hop on a quick follow-up call if that helps.

Best,
Alex Soto
Head of Partnerships, CloudCart
T: (415) 555-0199

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex@cloudcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum - clarifying pass-through billing & audit evidence

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear bullet list. Looping in legal (Kimberly), partnerships ops (Karthik) and partner contracts (Ben) so we can triage.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Invoice-level evidence: our Hosted API logs and billing system can produce per-invoice CSV exports tied to customer IDs and usage lines. We typically retain detailed billing records for 24 months by default; we can discuss extended retention if needed for reconciliation.
- Pass-through fees: we'll need to reconcile the marketplace fee language with the order form waterfall. Practically we can honor pass-through for charges that map to a single Account/OrderForm, but multi-tenant aggregation will need a scoped mechanism.
- Indemnity carveouts: Kimberly, can you review CloudCart's redlines for the indemnity language and propose a compromise?

Ben — can you pull the typical CSV export sample and a short runbook (what we can provide and the turnaround time)? Karthik — please advise on whether ops needs any special mapping for CloudCart's reseller flows.

I've attached our internal redline to help speed the review.

Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_Redline_20270322.docx (docx)

Thanks — I'll coordinate next steps after legal reviews.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena_ruiz@cloudcart.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Soto <alex@cloudcart.com>, CloudCart Legal <legal@cloudcart.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum - clarifying pass-through billing & audit evidence

Priya — thanks for the quick loop. Attached is a marked-up version of v2 with suggested indemnity language and a short addendum describing the evidence types our auditors will ask for (sample invoice, per-sku usage lines, and a reconciliation summary).

Two clarifications from our side:
1) Retention: 36 months would be ideal for our finance team. Is that feasible?
2) Format: CSV export that includes timestamp, SKU, quantity, unit price, taxes, and subtotal line-items.

If Redwood cannot share raw invoice PDFs due to customer privacy, an invoice-level CSV with masked customer IDs would work — we just need a reliable mapping/key so CloudCart can map back to billing lines for marketplace settlements.

Attachment: CloudCart_Evidence_Request_and_Indemnity_Markup.docx (docx)

On Tue, Mar 22, 2027 at 11:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear bullet list. Looping in legal (Kimberly), partnerships ops (Karthik) and partner contracts (Ben) so we can triage.
> 
> Quick responses to your asks: ...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum - clarifying pass-through billing & audit evidence

Thanks all — reviewed CloudCart's markup and ran a quick ops feasibility check. Notes below:

- Evidence exports: Ops can produce CSV exports with the fields requested (timestamp, SKU, qty, unit_price, taxes, subtotal). Turnaround: typical request — 3 business days; for programmatic access we can automate a scheduled export for recurring reconciliations (requires a signed data-sharing addendum).
- Retention: 24 months is standard; extending to 36 months is possible but will require a storage/retention add-on (ops can scope the cost impact).
- Masking: We can provide masked customer IDs and a mapping token that CloudCart can use. Full PDFs with PII would require customer consent or a reseller agreement that allows disclosure.
- Indemnity: Kimberly — my read is we can propose a middle path: narrow the carveout to liabilities arising solely from CloudCart's misconfiguration or marketplace billing disputes, and keep a general mutual indemnity otherwise.

Action items:
- Kimberly to propose redline language for indemnity and data-sharing that limits exposure and clarifies audit bounds (timeboxed, business-hours access, pre-notice).
- Karthik to confirm whether engineering needs an API contract change for scheduled exports.
- Priya to share a one-page SLA note with CloudCart on turnaround + cost options.

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/84732 (internal notes attached)
Attachment: HubSpot-DC-84732-notes.pdf (pdf)

Ben Carter
Partner Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex@cloudcart.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena_ruiz@cloudcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum - clarifying pass-through billing & audit evidence

Alex / Elena — quick summary and next steps from Redwood: 

- Evidence exports: Redwood can provide CSV exports with the requested fields. Ben estimates 3 business-day turnaround for ad-hoc requests; we can set up scheduled exports for ongoing reconciliation (would require a signed data-sharing addendum).
- Retention: Standard is 24 months. We can extend to 36 months under an add-on (ops will provide a cost estimate).
- Masking & privacy: We will provide masked customer IDs + mapping token. Full invoices (PDFs) with PII require either customer consent or a contract clause permitting disclosure — not standard.
- Indemnity: Kimberly is drafting a targeted indemnity redline that narrows the carveout to CloudCart-originated acts/omissions and billing disputes attributable to CloudCart. Kimberly — please share the language by end of day Thursday.

Next customer-facing deliverables (owner):
- Priya: send a one-page note outlining turnaround and cost options for retention extension (today EOD).
- Ben: attach sample CSV extract and runbook (3 business-day SLA) to the thread.
- Kimberly: legal redline for indemnity & audit scope (EOD Thu).
- Karthik: confirm any engineering prerequisites for scheduled export automation (end of week).

Can we aim for a call early next week to finalize wording? If so, share availability and we'll set up a 30-min slot.

Thanks — talk soon.

Priya Natarajan
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
